extracted.name: Cream Cheese Cucumber Sandwiches
extracted.description: Slices of cocktail rye bread are spread with a cream cheese mixture and topped with cucumber.
ingredient_lines: 1 (.7 ounce) package dry Italian-style salad dressing mix
instruction_lines: Stir whipped cream cheese and dry Italian-style dressing mix together in a small bowl until well combined. Spread evenly over cocktail rye bread slices; top each slice with a cucumber slice.
